marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Harry Potter AND THE PRISONER OF AZKABAN

As the despicable Aunt Marge Floats across the night sky, Harry heads off for what will become his third year at Hogwarts. A harrowing Alley ride on the Knight Bus places him in Diagon Alley where he learns that escaped prisoner, Sirius Black is coming for him. And so the new term begins. At Hogwards, Harry and friends learn the delicate art of approaching a Hippogriff, how to transforms shapeshifting Boggarts into hilarity and even turn back time. Soul-sucking Dementors hover over the school, threating Harry, while a supporter of the accursed He-Who-Cannot-Be-Named lurks within the castle and Harry will be forced to confront them all
